title: Accused standing outside the house now
proves: Immediate danger and indirect words about not wanting to be around are both understood, without the caller saying either outright.
summary: A caller says the people she complained against are standing outside her house right now and she has locked herself in. She speaks of being tired and says it might be better if she were not around.

steps.text: वो लोग अभी मेरे घर के बाहर खड़े हैं। मैंने दरवाज़ा बंद कर लिया है और अंदर बैठी हूँ।
steps.gloss: Those people are standing outside my house right now. I have shut the door and I am sitting inside.

steps.text: मैं बहुत थक गई हूँ। कभी लगता है कि मैं न रहूँ तो सबकी परेशानी ख़त्म हो जाएगी।
steps.gloss: I am very tired. Sometimes I feel that if I were not here, everyone's trouble would end.

steps.text: मुझे नहीं पता किससे बात करूँ।
steps.gloss: I do not know who to talk to.
